title: Pick a prompt. Make it [[yours]].
intro: Open to students from grade 7 to 12, in a Junior and a Senior category. Choose one of seven prompts on climate and sustainability, then sign up with the form for your school.

prompts.title: Your Plan of Action
prompts.question: If you could change the way we address one specific climate issue in the world, what would it be and how would you go about it?

prompts.title: The Economic Reality
prompts.question: What step towards advancement are we currently taking that is taking us two steps behind in sustainability?

prompts.title: The Climate Change Hypocrisy
prompts.question: Do we practice what we preach, or does our desire for comfort and convenience contradict our promises to protect the planet?

prompts.title: Who Pays the Bill
prompts.question: The communities that did the least to cause climate change are often the ones suffering most from it. Who owes them, and what should repayment look like beyond money?

prompts.title: Postcard from 2050
prompts.question: Imagine the world got climate action right. To you, what would an ordinary day in 2050 look like, and which decision we make today made it possible?

prompts.title: The Vegetarian Myth
prompts.question: Is being vegetarian as good for sustainability as people claim, or are we giving it more credit than it deserves? Justify.

prompts.title: Nature vs. Culture
prompts.question: Food is tied to religion, tradition and identity. Is it fair to ask communities to change what they eat for the sake of the climate?

rules: I will ensure that my essay is entirely my original work and will not plagiarize or use AI tools to generate its content. I will express my own thoughts, opinions and arguments honestly, acknowledge all external sources used, and ensure that no facts or statistics are fabricated. I will complete the essay independently without any unauthorized and/or external assistance. I understand that any violation of these conditions may result in my disqualification from the competition.
